# GitHub Discussions

Welcome to the Hentai-Senpai GTK Theme community discussions! This is the place for conversations, questions, sharing, and collaboration.

## 📋 Discussion Categories

We have organized discussions into the following categories:

### 💬 [General](../../discussions/categories/general)
**For:** General conversations and community chat  
**Topics:**
- Introductions and welcomes
- General questions about the theme
- Community announcements
- Off-topic conversations (keep it friendly!)
- Sharing thoughts and feedback

**Not for:** Bug reports, feature requests (use [Issues](../../issues) instead)

---

### 🎨 [Showcase](../../discussions/categories/showcase)
**For:** Sharing your desktop setups and customizations  
**Topics:**
- Desktop screenshots
- Custom color schemes
- Unique configurations
- Before/after transformations
- Integration with other themes

**Template available** - Check the category description for format

---

### 🐛 [Q&A](../../discussions/categories/q-a)
**For:** Help, troubleshooting, and questions  
**Topics:**
- Installation problems
- Theme not applying
- Compatibility questions
- "How do I...?" questions
- Error troubleshooting

**Before posting:**
1. Search existing discussions
2. Check the [Troubleshooting Guide](../../wiki/Troubleshooting)
3. Include system information (OS, DE, version)

---

### 💡 [Ideas](../../discussions/categories/ideas)
**For:** Feature suggestions and improvements  
**Topics:**
- New features
- Design improvements
- Color variants
- Component support
- UX enhancements

**Process:**
1. Share your idea
2. Community votes with 👍/👎
3. Popular ideas may become [Issues](../../issues)

---

### 🔧 [Development](../../discussions/categories/development)
**For:** Technical discussions and contributions  
**Topics:**
- Development setup help
- Build process questions
- Code structure discussions
- Contribution planning
- Testing and debugging
- Release planning

**Resources:**
- [Contributing Guide](../../wiki/Contributing)
- [Code Documentation](../../wiki)

---

### 📢 [Announcements](../../discussions/categories/announcements)
**For:** Official announcements (maintainers only)  
**Topics:**
- New releases
- Important updates
- Breaking changes
- Community news

---

## 🏷️ Using Labels

When creating a discussion, you can add labels to help categorize it:

**Type Labels:**
- `question` - Looking for help
- `showcase` - Sharing your setup
- `idea` - Suggestion or proposal
- `help wanted` - Looking for assistance

**Topic Labels:**
- `gtk2`, `gtk3`, `gtk4` - Component-specific
- `gnome`, `cinnamon`, `xfce` - DE-specific
- `docs` - Documentation related
- `translation` - i18n/l10n related

## ✅ Best Practices

### Do:
- ✅ Search before posting
- ✅ Use appropriate categories
- ✅ Be respectful and constructive
- ✅ Include relevant details (screenshots, system info)
- ✅ Mark answers as "Accepted" when resolved
- ✅ Vote on ideas you support

### Don't:
- ❌ Post bug reports (use [Issues](../../issues))
- ❌ Post feature requests (use [Ideas](../../discussions/categories/ideas) then create Issue if popular)
- ❌ Spam or self-promote
- ❌ Be rude or dismissive
- ❌ Post off-topic content in technical categories

## 🔍 Finding Discussions

- **Search:** Use the search bar at the top
- **Filter:** Filter by category, label, or answered/unanswered
- **Sort:** Sort by newest, most commented, or most reacted

## 📞 Getting Help

1. **Quick Questions:** [Q&A Category](../../discussions/categories/q-a)
2. **Complex Issues:** [Open an Issue](../../issues/new/choose)
3. **Private Matters:** [Email maintainer](mailto:)

## 🎯 Discussion vs Issue

| Use Discussion | Use Issue |
|----------------|-----------|
| Questions | Bug reports |
| Ideas brainstorming | Confirmed bugs |
| Help requests | Feature requests ready for implementation |
| Community chat | Tasks for developers |
| Showcases | Technical debt tracking |

## 📈 Discussion Stats

- **Total Discussions:** [View all](../../discussions)
- **Answered Questions:** Filter by "Answered"
- **Popular Ideas:** Sort by reactions

---

Join the conversation! Everyone is welcome to participate:
- Ask questions

**Code of Conduct:** Be respectful, constructive, and helpful. We're all here because we love Linux theming!
